cases.title: T1 creates the invocation with its rows in one commit
cases.when: A task tool is called with a business key, and an ASK tool without one
then: Invocation, task, business-key and approval rows exist exactly as T1 lists
CreateTaskResult is sent only after the commit

cases.title: T2 approval queues the invocation in one transaction
then: Approval APPROVED and invocation QUEUED in one commit

cases.title: T3 deny cancels and rejects the key
cases.when: An approver denies, then another approval is revoked
then: Invocation CANCELLED, task REJECTED, business-key outcome REJECTED

cases.title: T4 reserve consumes the approval once and mints the permit
cases.when: Two reserve calls race for one approved invocation
then: One nonce row and one permit; the other gets the same state back or a refusal

cases.title: T5 consume starts the lease and returns the fencing token
cases.when: The host in aud consumes the permit
then: lease_holder and lease_expires_at set; fencingToken equals the nonce

cases.title: T6 heartbeats renew the lease within the deadline
cases.when: The host heartbeats every lease/3 past the deadline
then: lease_expires_at never exceeds deadline + 5 s
A TERMINATE kill stops renewal

cases.title: T7 enters and leaves INPUT_REQUIRED
cases.when: The host sends inputRequest, then the Gateway posts input with the owner digest
then: task_input_deadline_at is set then cleared; the next LeaseRenewal carries inputResponses
A wrong owner digest gets not found

cases.title: T8 cancel invalidates the fencing token
cases.when: tasks/cancel arrives for QUEUED, PENDING_APPROVAL and EXECUTING invocations
then: QUEUED and PENDING_APPROVAL go to CANCELLED
EXECUTING goes to CANCEL_REQUESTED; secret delivery and broker checks fail; the next heartbeat returns cancelRequested

cases.title: T9 result commits terminal state, result, key outcome and outbox
cases.when: The host reports a result with a valid token, then repeats it
then: One terminal transition; the repeat is a no-op
A result above 64 KiB lands in control_invocation_results

cases.title: T10 FAILED notStarted allows rebinding
cases.when: The host reports FAILED with notStarted after a spool failure
then: not_started true; the business key may be rebound

cases.title: T11 lease expiry by effect class
cases.when: Leases expire for a ledger tool, a non-ledger task at attempt 1 and at attempt 3
then: Ledger: OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
Non-ledger attempt 1: QUEUED with a new attempt
Attempt 3: FAILED; lease columns kept

cases.title: T12 expiry before consumption
cases.when: An approval, a queued pickup and an input request each pass their deadline
then: EXPIRED; any nonce left unconsumed

cases.title: T13 a late result or reconcile resolves OUTCOME_UNKNOWN once
cases.when: A late report arrives with the old token, then a second contradicting one
then: First moves to SUCCEEDED, FAILED or PARTIAL with evidence
Second is evidence only; never back to OUTCOME_UNKNOWN

cases.title: T14 purge tombstones results without changing state
then: Payload replaced by tombstone; business-key row tombstoned; state unchanged

cases.title: A transition not in the table gets 409
cases.when: A host reports a result for a QUEUED invocation, and a heartbeat for a SUCCEEDED one
then: 409 each

cases.title: Control calls replay on Idempotency-Key
cases.when: Each caller endpoint is called twice with the same Idempotency-Key and the response is dropped the first time
then: The second call replays the first response; nothing is applied twice
